items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I'm thinking of calling his brother [Caesar] to find out if he ever gave this a title or what

ctx.x: and compose these tunes, and Tad would say, okay, now John, you're going to do this, that's the last I would hear. But I loved him, so, you know we were -- and he was a very talented man. Yeah. [PAUSE]

As a matter of fact, Tad and I did one tune together. I don't even know the name of it, I don't know whether it was even ever copyrighted or anything, but I am going to take a chance and do this tune and give it a name, and I'm going to record it. Now, I'm thinking of calling his brother [Caesar] to find out if he ever gave this a title or what, but actually it was my idea and we just expanded it. And I've never performed it, I've played it for many people, guitarists and they all want to perform it, but I won't…
